_doc: V31 Korean source fixes where the Korean contradicted the V29 contract, Korean submission law or the data flow (REPORT §425). Found by the English editors (EN_AUDIT.md, EN_CONSOLES_AUDIT.md).

agency:v29.plan.duty.dorm.APPLICATION.en: Dorm: application help and other housing options
agency:v29.plan.duty.dorm.APPLICATION.why: MEANING: 신청 대행 = applying on the student's behalf; contract = application support

agency:v29.plan.unrationed.CONTRACTED_DO.ko: 계약한 서류·일정 안에서 횟수 제한 없음
agency:v29.plan.unrationed.CONTRACTED_DO.en: No limit within the contracted documents and schedule
agency:v29.plan.unrationed.CONTRACTED_DO.why: MEANING: scope must keep 'schedule'; '무제한' alone over-promises

student:v4.ws.team.final.ko: 최종 확인 후 학생이 직접 {{university}}에 제출
student:v4.ws.team.final.en: Final check before you submit to {{university}}
student:v4.ws.team.final.why: MEANING: applicants submit personally (Korean law); Korean read as the team submitting

student:phase.prepare.text.ko: 서류를 모아 검토받고, 한귤 상담팀의 피드백을 받으며 자기소개서와 학업계획서를 작성합니다.
student:phase.prepare.text.en: Gather your documents and get them checked, then write your personal statement and study plan with feedback from the Hangyul team.
student:phase.prepare.text.why: MEANING: 함께 작성 read as co-writing; editing ≠ writing for the student

student:register.privacyNote.ko: 서류와 개인정보는 나를 담당하는 한귤 상담팀(협력 유학원 포함)과 내가 선택한 대학에만 공유됩니다. 언제든 데이터를 내보내거나 삭제할 수 있어요.
student:register.privacyNote.en: Your documents and personal details are shared only with the Hangyul team that supports you (including its partner agency) and the universities you choose. You can export or delete your data at any time.
student:register.privacyNote.why: ACCURACY: the partner agency that serves the student also receives the data
